items.q: Tattaca, tetaca, tetaca. Yeah. Especially on trumpet.

ctx.x: Tattaca, tetaca, tetaca. Yeah. Especially on trumpet. But in jazz is not necessary. You don't have occasion to use that. For clarinet, that's the double tonguing or tripletongue. Yeah. Just the staccato and legato toning. Yeah.
Can you tell us about developing your finger technique, any special exercises?
